I fixed the Household expenses page. I haven't opened it in the app, so I haven't seen it render.

There were two bugs:
- **Wrong table lookup:** the page looked for `note.table`, but the data is in `note.tables`. This is why the page showed nothing.
- **Amount column not recognised:** your column is named "Amt", and the page only matched names like "Amount", "Cost" or "Price". I added "Amt" to the names it accepts.

I also made the page fall back to its saved data when none is passed to it, so a limit you set is still read.

It opens on October, since today is in October, so it should show 10 235 kr. That is Rent 9 500 plus Groceries 735. The month picker switches to September. Your note's table and text are unchanged.
